parameters.jsCode: const response = $input.first().json; let text = response?.candidates?.[0]?.content?.parts?.[0]?.text; if (!text) throw new Error('Gemini returned no final post.'); text = text.replace(/^```json\s*/i, '').replace(/^```\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/i, '').trim(); const parsed = JSON.parse(text); if (!parsed.post_text) throw new Error('No post_text returned.'); if (parsed.post_text.length > 1800) throw new Error('Post exceeds 1800 characters.'); return [{ json: { ...parsed, experience_row: $('Select Unused Experience').first().json.row_number, experience_id: $('Select Unused Experience').first().json['Experience ID'] } }];
